migration_report_metadata.report_title: ADO.NET SQL Server to PostgreSQL Migration - Final Report

equivalency_validation_statistics.equivalency_validation_note: All 7 statement pairs tested through SQL Equivalency tool. All returned ERROR status with 'uniqueID' error. No agent judgment was used.

detailed_statement_conversion_results.statement_type: SELECT with CTE and Window Functions
changes_applied: Added semicolon terminator
Window functions (AVG OVER, COUNT OVER) already PostgreSQL compatible

detailed_statement_conversion_results.statement_type: SELECT with CTE and LAG Window Function
changes_applied: Added semicolon terminator
LAG window function already PostgreSQL compatible

detailed_statement_conversion_results.statement_type: Multi-statement Transaction (INSERT with History and Stats)
changes_applied: Removed T-SQL DECLARE statement
Removed BEGIN TRANSACTION/COMMIT (moved to C# NpgsqlTransaction)
Replaced SCOPE_IDENTITY() with RETURNING ProductId clause
Replaced GETDATE() with CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
Split into 3 separate SQL statements within C# transaction
Added proper try/catch with rollback

detailed_statement_conversion_results.statement_type: Multi-statement Transaction (UPDATE with History and Stats)
changes_applied: Removed BEGIN TRANSACTION/COMMIT (moved to C# NpgsqlTransaction)
Removed T-SQL DECLARE statements (captured in C# variables)
Replaced GETDATE() with CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
Split into 4 separate operations within transaction
Added proper error handling

detailed_statement_conversion_results.statement_type: Multi-statement Transaction (DELETE with History and Stats)
changes_applied: Removed BEGIN TRANSACTION/COMMIT (moved to C# NpgsqlTransaction)
Removed T-SQL DECLARE statements (captured in C# variables)
Replaced GETDATE() with CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
Split into 4 separate operations within transaction
Added proper error handling
